name: Shigino
source: One of the characters of the Matchmaker story. Key member of the Okiai Syndicate. [spoiler]Main person behind the events that led to the downfall of Tsuki Shinkai and allowed the syndicate to be reborn in the 25th ward. After that, he is contracted by the ward office to carry out operations against the Regional Adjustment Bureau.[/spoiler]
